Name: Quartermaster_Wilds_Dialogue
$Comment: Wilds quartermaster (turn-in giver for wilds_quartermasters_ledger). Native schema (1.5.0): a fully-resolved standalone tree, with no template inheritance to chase. greet_active shows while the ledger quest is ACTIVE (turn it in here + browse quests); otherwise greet offers browse-quests + a trade flavor beat. A future set of givers that share a skeleton should use native 'Parent' inheritance (a base dialogue in Dialogues/ or DialogueTemplates/, inherited by 'Parent':'<id>' with node-keyed merge), not a params template.
